dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Forest Rangers are civil servants too...

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: ...You can't just lump them all together because they are all civil servants!

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: Let me give you an example... It's like... It's like how Bouncy Mushrooms and Floppy Mushrooms are all mushrooms, but their characteristics are completely different. Get it?

dialogues.speaker: Umm
dialogues.text: You know what? Instead of asking me more questions, why don't you just stay a few days? I'm certain you'll understand the simplicity and beauty of forest life then.
